disambiguation: Not a general publishing tool; it is a specialized Markdown typesetting workbench for WeChat Official Account formatting.
extras: Free and desktop-only; operates entirely locally with no telemetry, payment, or AI service required.
intentEvidence: An independently maintained Markdown typesetting workbench for Obsidian: WeChat Official Account formatting, rich-text copying, image export, and optional note layout enhancements.
problem: Users need a way to format and prepare Markdown content for WeChat Official Account publishing without leaving the Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: Historical releases used MIT-licensed upstream implementation.

summary: An independently maintained Markdown typesetting workbench that converts Markdown into rich text suitable for WeChat Official Account publishing, offering themes and local layout enhancements.
